description: Brown Butter Chocolate Chunk Cookie Recipe 🍪🤎🍪 If you’re looking for a classic chocolate chunk cookie recipe that will impress, this one is for you 🤭 Ingredients: - 155g browned butter - 140g light brown sugar  - 60g granulated sugar  - 1 egg and 1 egg yolk - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1 tbsp double cream  - 240g plain flour  - 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp bicarbonate soda and 1// tsp salt  - 100g milk chocolate chunks  - 100g dark chocolate chunks  - 50g milk chocolate chips (optional)  Bake at 180 degrees celcius for 10-12 minutes ✨ PS if you’re new here, I would definitely recommend giving this a go if you aren’t sure which recipe to try first!  #cookies #cookie #baking #baker #Recipe
transcript: One thing I've always wanted to master is the perfect chocolate chunk cookie and after lots of recipe testing I think I might have actually done it. So if you're new here and looking for a good classic cookie recipe to try I suggest this one. I start off with 155 grams of browned butter. I brown this in a pan for about five minutes on a medium heat. You do need to keep stirring it when you're melting it and then you need to wait for this to cool before you add it into your bowl and start your cookies. I then add 140 grams of light brown sugar, 60 grams of granulated sugar and I give this a good whisk. I then add in one egg and one egg yolk along with a teaspoon of vanilla extract and then give this a good whisk until it's slightly lighter in color. Then you want to add in a tablespoon of double cream. I do too because my tablespoons are quite shallow and then again give this a good whisk until it's slightly lighter in color. It's then time to add 240 grams of plain flour, half a teaspoon of bicarbonate of soda, half a teaspoon of baking powder and half a teaspoon of salt. Give that a mix and then fold in 100 grams of milk chocolate chunks and 100 grams of dark chocolate chunks. I save some of these to add on at the end too. It's optional but I also add in 50 grams of milk chocolate chips just to give it a little bit of variation. I weigh my dough and divide by however many cookies I want. These ones were about 100 grams each. Then pop them in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 12 minutes. I keep an eye on them until the top goes golden and then this is what you're left with. As you can see I added on some more chocolate chunks on top. I was so happy with how these turned out so definitely let me know if you give them a go.
